response.sql:
WITH filtered_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ab.translink,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  WHERE ab.peercorr >= 0.149
    AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  translink,
  ordertypedist,
  record_count,
  CAST(record_count AS FLOAT) / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) as fraction
FROM filtered_data
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The phrase "high peer correlation cutoff of 0.149" is interpreted as peercorr >= 0.149 (inclusive boundary), following standard threshold conventions where a cutoff value includes the boundary itself.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff is meant to be strictly exclusive (peercorr > 0.149 rather than >= 0.149), replace the >= operator with > in the WHERE clause.
